sources.excerpt: "worked with Republicans to deliver the largest property tax cut in Texas history"
sources.note: States a position: for a middle-class tax cut (expanded Child Tax Credit and EITC, restored ACA credits, a tariff rebate), paid for by higher taxes on billionaires and corporations. Also for a $15 minimum wage, repealing Trump tariffs, capping credit card interest rates, and lowering healthcare, housing, grocery and energy costs. The page itself has no date; the embedded posts are dated May 2021 to Aug 2026.

sources.note: Official campaign messaging, tagged Economy/Affordability. States a position: cut taxes for working people, cap credit card interest, temporarily suspend federal gas and diesel taxes, and fund this by having the wealthiest pay more. The page has no date.
